杰克的生活方式(Jack's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

The experience taught Jack more than any book could. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. In fact, queues at the till tempt impulse purchases.

Little by little, things began to change. People around Jack often share different ideas about the corner store. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, delivery is free for orders over fifty yuan.

Jack's dream job is to be a cook. The city library has become an important part of daily life. On Monday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. Curiosity is the best motivator for learning something new.

Jack plans to study music harder this term. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What's more, the road's gentle undulation makes it popular with cyclists.
Jack will take part in a baseball match in April. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The corner store looked quieter than usual that evening.
